uris.description: LDAP server URIs to connect to (support failover via multiple URIs).

base_dn.description: Base DN where user entries are searched.

search_scope.description: LDAP search scope: 'sub' (subtree), 'one' (one level), 'base' (single entry), or 'children' (children of base).

bind_dn.description: DN to bind with when connecting (leave empty for anonymous bind).

bind_password.description: Password for bind DN. Leave empty if anonymous bind is used.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for non-ldaps connections (uses ldaps:// or starttls).

ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file for validating LDAP server certificate (required for ldaps/TLS).

client_cert_path.description: Path to client certificate (for mutual TLS authentication).

client_key_path.description: Path to client private key (for mutual TLS authentication).

user_filter.description: LDAP filter used to locate user entries during authentication.

password_scheme.description: Password storage scheme used in LDAP (e.g., SSHA, MD5, CRYPT, PLAIN).

extra_user_attrs.description: Additional LDAP attributes to map to Dovecot user fields. Each item defines `ldap_attr` and `local_name`.

local_name.description: Dovecot internal field name to populate (e.g., 'maildrop').

enable_referrals.description: Enable chasing LDAP referrals (useful in multi-DC forests).

ldap_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LDAP operations (0 = no limit).

ldap_idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before LDAP connection is closed.

ldap_reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after a connection failure.

max_pending_ops.description: Maximum number of pending LDAP operations per connection.

enable_starttls.description: Explicitly enable STARTTLS when using plain LDAP (requires 'uris' to include ldap://).

group_base_dn.description: Base DN for group searches (if different from user base).

group_search_scope.description: Scope for group LDAP searches (same values as 'search_scope').

enable_debug.description: Enable verbose LDAP debugging in Dovecot logs (only for troubleshooting).

tls_cipher_list.description: Custom cipher list for TLS (system default if empty).

sasl_mech.description: SASL mechanism to use (e.g., 'GSSAPI' for Kerberos).
